name: AccordionRow
description: Piqueray AccordionRow. Visual anatomy, layout, dimensions, typography, colors and visibility are adopted from the validated read-only Figma extraction. Native button, toggle and ARIA semantics are intentionally deferred to a separately proven semantic-wrapper capability.

props.name: etat
props.description: Controlled when supplied; otherwise toggles independently between fermé and ouvert.
